items.title: 〈港股盤後〉科網股活躍 恒指漲0.24% PCB概念與黃金板塊強勢爆發
items.title_en: Hong Kong Stocks After Hours: Tech Stocks Active, Hang Seng Index Up 0.24%, PCB Concept and Gold Sectors Surge
paras: 港股主要指數周三(5日)收漲，市場情緒總體活躍，但各行業表現有所分化。截至收盤，恒生指數上漲0.24%，收報25,915.32點；恒生科技指數表現較佳，收漲0.97%；國企指數則上升0.34%。當日大市成交額達2,780.43億港元，顯示資金參與度高。
大型科網股漲多跌少，聯想集團表現亮眼，漲幅近6%；阿里巴巴與百度分別上漲約1.8%與1.6%，騰訊也錄得約1%的升幅。然而，小米集團與網易則逆市下跌超過1%。
PCB概念股成為今日市場焦點，板塊全線爆發。受AI伺服器及算力需求激增推動，加上電子布價格飆升引發覆銅板（CCL）提價預期，PCB產業鏈正進入量價齊升階段。其中，勝宏科技大漲逾16%領銜，建滔積層板亦漲逾10%。此外，由於全球三大存儲巨頭產能售罄，存儲半導體股全天活躍，中芯國際與兆易創新等個股皆有強勢表現。
黃金與資源板塊持續狂飆。隨著現貨金價站上4,170美元/盎司，避險情緒與資源價值重估推動金礦股集體走高。中國黃金國際漲逾13%，龍資源則因預告上半年利潤大幅增長，股價狂飆逾41%。
相較之下，石油與金融板塊集體承壓。受美伊有望達成霍爾木茲海峽協議的預期影響，國際油價顯著回落，導致「三桶油」齊跌，中國海洋石油跌逾2%。光通信板塊則受美國禁令傳聞攪動，中際旭創收跌5.18%
。銀行股同樣表現分化，匯豐控股受業務調整影響跌逾2.6%，內銀股亦延續調整態勢。
paras_en: Hong Kong's main indices closed higher on Wednesday (the 5th), with overall market sentiment active but performance diverging across sectors. At the close, the Hang Seng Index rose 0.24% to 25,915.32 points; the Hang Seng Tech Index performed better, gaining 0.97%; and the China Enterprises Index rose 0.34%. Total market turnover that day reached HK$278.043 billion, indicating strong participation.

Large-cap tech stocks saw more gains than losses, with Lenovo Group standing out, up nearly 6%; Alibaba and Baidu rose about 1.8% and 1.6% respectively, and Tencent posted roughly a 1% increase. In contrast, Xiaomi Group and NetEase fell more than 1% against the market trend.

PCB‑related stocks were the day's market focus, with the sector exploding across the board. Driven by a surge in AI server and computing power demand and a sharp rise in electronic substrate prices that sparked expectations of higher copper‑clad laminate (CCL) pricing, the PCB industry chain is entering a phase of simultaneous volume and price growth. Among them, Victory Technology surged over 16% leading the pack, while Jintao Laminates jumped more than 10%. Additionally, with the world’s three biggest storage‑chip makers running out of capacity, storage semiconductor stocks were active all day, with SMIC and GigaDevice showing strong performance.

Gold and resource stocks continued their rally. As spot gold topped US$4,170 per ounce, hedging sentiment and a re‑valuation of resource assets lifted gold‑mining stocks across the board. China Gold International rose over 13%, and Longyuan Resources surged more than 41% after announcing a large profit increase for the first half of the year.

By contrast, oil and financial sectors faced pressure. Expectations that the U.S. and Iran might reach an agreement on the Strait of Hormuz pulled international oil prices sharply lower, causing all three major Chinese oil firms to fall, with China National Offshore Oil Corp down more than 2%. The optical‑communication sector was rattled by rumors of a U.S. ban, with Zhongji Xuchuang dropping 5.18%.
Bank stocks also showed mixed performance: HSBC Holdings fell over 2.6% due to business adjustments, and domestic banks continued their downward trend.

items.title: SpaceX宣示搶攻行動通訊市場 分析師：五年內難撼動美電信三雄
items.title_en: SpaceX Declares Push into Mobile Communications Market; Analysts Say It Won’t Disrupt the Big Three U.S. Telcos Within Five Years
paras: SpaceX(SPCX-US)周二(4日)首度明確表態，將利用收購的無線頻譜打造完整行動通訊服務，未來星鏈(Starlink)可望直接挑戰美國三大電信商威瑞森(Verizon)(VZ-US)、AT&T(T-US)及T-Mobile(TMUS-US)，消息一出三家公司盤後股價下跌。
SpaceX去年透過兩筆交易，以196億美元向EchoStar(ECHO-US)收購65MHz無線頻譜的使用權，為Starlink跨足行動通訊市場奠定基礎。
SpaceX總裁蕭特威爾(Gwynne Shotwell)在財報電話會議上說：「我們向EchoStar取得的頻譜包含地面通訊用途，因此我們確實打算建立地面網路。」
她表示，公司將建置所需基礎設施，使Starlink成為「真正的行動通訊服務」，並預期可望從三大電信商手中搶下「相當多」客戶。
這是SpaceX首次清楚說明，未來將結合衛星網路與地面基地台，打造完整無線通訊服務，而不再只是目前於偏遠地區提供D2D(Direct-to-Device)衛星直連手機服務。
消息公布後，美國三大電信商股價盤後走低，Verizon跌約4%，AT&T跌約2.2%，T-Mobile跌約3%。

分析師：複製全美電信網路並不容易

Starlink目前仍是SpaceX最主要的獲利來源，也是支撐馬斯克投入AI、資料中心及新一代火箭研發的重要現金流。不過多數分析師認為，將Starlink發展成全美行動通訊服務仍需投入多年時間與龐大資本。
美國三大電信商過去30年投入數千億美元，購買頻譜、建置與升級基地台網路，並持續投入大量資金爭取與維繫用戶，這些優勢並非SpaceX短時間內可複製。
MoffettNathanson分析師Craig Moffett表示，除非Starlink能與既有電信商簽署虛擬行動網路業者(Mobile Virtual Network Operator, MVNO)合作協議，取得基本覆蓋能力，否則很難想像未來五年內，這種直接面向消費者推出的服務能與既有電信商競爭。
MVNO是指不自行建置全國行動網路，而是向既有電信商租用網路容量，再以自有品牌提供服務。
對於建置行動通訊網路所需成本，蕭特威爾並未透露具體金額，僅表示已有「非常新穎」的方法，用更具資本效率的方式完成網路建設。
New Street Research分析師David Barden指出，美國三大電信商合計持有約1000MHz頻譜，相較之下，SpaceX僅取得65MHz頻譜，「要試圖複製三十年來建立的地面網路，並不合理。」

部分投資人看好顛覆潛力

儘管市場普遍保守，仍有部分投資人認為，市場低估SpaceX對電信產業帶來的衝擊。Aptus Capital Advisors投資組合經理David Wagner表示，馬斯克在法說會提到，市場低估這項業務價值，「我完全認同這項看法。」
Wagner認為，相較於傳統電信商，SpaceX更具持續創新能力，未來可能快速改變產業競爭格局。
目前SpaceX已與T-Mobile合作，利用Starlink衛星為相容智慧手機提供衛星直連(Direct-to-Cell)服務，在傳統基地台無法覆蓋地區提供補充訊號，但現階段仍屬互補關係，而非直接競爭。
paras_en: SpaceX (SPCX-US) on Tuesday (the 4th) made its first clear statement that it will use the wireless spectrum it acquired to build a full mobile communications service, and Starlink could eventually directly challenge the three major U.S. telecom operators Verizon (VZ-US), AT&T (T-US) and T‑Mobile (TMUS-US). The news sent the after‑hours stock prices of the three companies lower.

Last year SpaceX bought the rights to 65 MHz of wireless spectrum from EchoStar (ECHO-US) for $19.6 billion in two transactions, laying the groundwork for Starlink’s entry into the mobile communications market.

SpaceX President Gwynne Shotwell said at the earnings call, “The spectrum we obtained from EchoStar includes ground‑based communications use, so we do indeed intend to build a terrestrial network.” She added that the company will construct the necessary infrastructure to make Starlink a “real mobile communications service” and expects to win “a substantial amount” of customers from the three incumbents.

This is the first time SpaceX has explicitly said it will combine its satellite network with ground base stations to create a complete wireless communications service, moving beyond its current direct‑to‑device satellite phone service that is limited to remote areas.
After the announcement, the after‑hours shares of the three U.S. telcos fell: Verizon down about 4%, AT&T down about 2.2% and T‑Mobile down about 3%.
Analysts: Replicating the U.S. telecom network is not easy

Starlink remains SpaceX’s primary profit source and the cash flow that underpins Elon Musk’s investments in AI, data centers and next‑generation rockets. However, most analysts believe turning Starlink into a nationwide mobile service will require many years and massive capital.

The three U.S. telcos have spent hundreds of billions of dollars over the past 30 years buying spectrum, building and upgrading base‑station networks, and continuously investing to acquire and retain customers – advantages that SpaceX cannot replicate quickly.

MoffettNathanson analyst Craig Moffett said that unless Starlink signs a Mobile Virtual Network Operator (MVNO) agreement with existing carriers to obtain basic coverage, it is hard to imagine a consumer‑facing service competing with incumbents within five years.
An MVNO does not build its own nationwide network but rents capacity from existing carriers and offers service under its own brand.
Shotwell did not disclose the cost of building a mobile network, only that SpaceX has a “very novel” and more capital‑efficient approach to constructing it.

New Street Research analyst David Barden noted that the three U.S. telcos together hold roughly 1,000 MHz of spectrum, whereas SpaceX has only secured 65 MHz, making it unreasonable to try to replicate a network built over three decades.
Some investors see disruptive potential

Despite the generally cautious market, some investors believe the impact of SpaceX on the telecom industry is undervalued. Aptus Capital Advisors portfolio manager David Wagner said Musk’s remarks at the earnings call suggest the market underestimates the business’s value, and he fully agrees.
Wagner argues that, compared with traditional telcos, SpaceX has greater capacity for continuous innovation and could quickly reshape industry competition.

SpaceX is already working with T‑Mobile to provide Direct‑to‑Cell satellite connectivity for compatible smartphones, supplementing coverage in areas where traditional base stations cannot reach. At present this remains a complementary relationship rather than direct competition.

items.title: 費半階段性高點修正觸底 法人：半導體ETF打折潮後買點現
items.title_en: Semiconductor ETFs Hit Bottom After Correction, Institutions: Buying Opportunity Emerges After Discount
paras: 7 月美費半急跌、從6/22最高14,655.29點一路殺至7/17的11,194.60點止跌，波段跌幅高達-23.61%，國內半導體股也跌得鼻青臉腫，不少投資人擔心半導體股轉入熊市，不過，投信法人指出，四大雲端巨頭陸續公布最新財報後，AI資本支出金額續增，顯示AI需求暢旺，中長線成長趨勢不變，7月半導體股整體急跌，可視為階段性高點修正觸底，建議投資人著眼AI中長期成長潛力，趁8月股價震盪階段，分批布局半導體相關ETF或基金，掌握股價打折潮後的相對低點，迎接第四季台股作夢行情。
根據集保統計，截至7/31止，國內半導體ETF整體受益人數，最新來到44萬256人，較前一週的43萬8,128人，新增2,128人，再創歷史新高；最新零股人數，也維持約6.5萬人左右，居歷史高檔。若與上月相比，整體半導體ETF受益人數較6月底新增約6.6萬人左右，較去年12月底人數，也大幅增加20萬人，成長率高達84.85%，顯示今年半導體ETF受惠AI浪潮，股價大漲的同時也展現高人氣。
台新臺灣半導體30 (00904-TW) ETF經理人張意聆表示，7月半導體股大跌後急彈，反映AI進入獲利驗證期，引發資金流出高資本支出的科技股，半導體股價也陷入修正，不過，觀察美科技巨頭最新公布的財報，像CSP雲端龍頭企業，仍維持新增AI資本支出計劃；同時，CSP財報內容中，AI投資也有反映公司獲利成長跡象，顯示科技大廠新增AI投資，有助於持續創造高於資金成本的價值。
張意聆強調，目前科技大廠的AI建置處於技術投資初期，2026年算是爬坡期，對於預估未來AI收入及生產效益將於2027年滯後顯現，預估半導體股價短期內，仍將受高利率、AI商業化驗證壓抑評價，但進入8月起至今年底，只要美國利率緊縮預期降溫，資金壓力緩解，半導體股估值有望快速修復，7月股價下殺應屬正常牛市整理，整體科技股估值修復時點，可能落在今年第四季。
台新投信ETF投資團隊指出，台股8月起持續展開反攻，加權指數重新站回各條均線之上，除被動元件與記憶體族群止跌回升後，半導體權值股中的台積電、聯發科也同步走強，持續扮演支撐大盤的重要多頭力量，對於具台積電的高含積半導體ETF，股價也有機會隨AI落地題材發威，是掌握第三、四季台股反彈行情的多頭主攻手，值得投資人優先卡位布局。

paras_en: The US semiconductor index plummeted in July, falling from its highest point of 14,655.29 on June 22 to 11,194.60 on July 17, a drop of 23.61%. Domestic semiconductor stocks also fell sharply, leaving many investors worried that the sector is entering a bear market. However, institutional investors pointed out that after the four major cloud giants announced their latest financial reports, AI capital expenditures continued to increase, indicating strong demand for AI and an unchanged long-term growth trend. The sharp drop in semiconductor stocks in July can be seen as a correction and a buying opportunity, and investors are advised to focus on the long-term growth potential of AI and take advantage of the price fluctuations in August to invest in semiconductor-related ETFs or funds.

According to the Taiwan Depository & Clearing Corporation, as of July 31, the number of beneficiaries of domestic semiconductor ETFs reached a new high of 442,256, an increase of 2,128 from the previous week. The number of zero-share holders remained at around 65,000, a historical high. Compared to the previous month, the number of beneficiaries of semiconductor ETFs increased by approximately 66,000 from the end of June, and by 200,000 from the end of last year, with a growth rate of 84.85%. This shows that semiconductor ETFs have been popular this year, driven by the AI trend, with prices rising and high demand.

The manager of the Fubon Taiwan Semiconductor 30 ETF (00904-TW), Chang Yi-Ling, stated that after the sharp drop in semiconductor stocks in July, the subsequent rebound reflects the entry into a period of profit verification for AI, leading to a outflow of funds from high-capital-expenditure tech stocks and a correction in semiconductor stock prices. However, observing the latest financial reports of US tech giants, such as CSP, a cloud leader, AI capital expenditures continue to increase, and AI investments are also reflected in the company's profit growth, indicating that tech giants' AI investments can create value above their cost of capital.

Chang emphasized that the current AI investment by tech giants is in its early stages, with 2026 being a period of rapid growth, and the benefits of AI revenue and production are expected to emerge in 2027. It is expected that semiconductor stock prices will continue to be suppressed by high interest rates and AI commercialization verification in the short term, but from August to the end of the year, if US interest rate expectations cool down and funding pressure eases, semiconductor stock valuations are likely to recover quickly, and the July price drop should be seen as a normal bull market correction. The timing of the overall tech stock valuation recovery may be in the fourth quarter.

Fubon Asset Management's ETF investment team pointed out that the Taiwanese stock market will continue to rebound from August, with the weighted index regaining its footing above the moving averages. In addition to the rebound of passive components and memory chips, semiconductor heavyweights such as TSMC and MediaTek are also gaining strength, playing an important role in supporting the market. For high-conviction semiconductor ETFs with TSMC, there is also an opportunity for prices to rise with the AI theme, making them a key player in the third and fourth quarter market rebound, and worth investors' attention and investment.

items.title: 大立光7月營收48.77億元月增31.38% 本月拉貨動能再看增
items.title_en: Largan Precision Reports July Revenue of NT$4.877 Billion, Up 31.38% MoM; Momentum from Stockpiling Expected to Continue Growing
paras: 積極投入 AI 應用光通訊元件開發的蘋果光學元件供應鏈大立光 (3008-TW)， 今 (5) 日公布最新營收資訊，大立光 2026 年 7月營收爲 48.77 億元，月增31.38%，年減10.66%，大立光度過6月客戶端在進行新舊機種交替期而推升7 月營收動能回升，以目前大立光掌握的訂單來看，大立光8月營運動能還要再增。
大立光 7月 營收結構中，以 1000 萬畫素產品占多數，占比約 60-70%，2000 萬畫素產品占比 10-20%，800 萬畫素產品 0-10%，低於 500 萬畫素產品占比 10-20%。
大立光在台中工業區購地接連出手加碼中，同時，大立光董事會決議對 2026 年上半年的股利配發案，將配發每股 41.5 元，而依大立光歷年行事曆，大立光上半年的股息將在 8 月 13 日除息交易。
大立光通過 2026 年上半年財報，營收 292.09 億元，毛利率 49.41%，稅後純益 107.93 億元，每股純益 82.35 元。以 41.5 元的上半年配息而言，盈餘配發率爲 50.39%。大立光上半年配息也優於去年同期的 28 元。
大立光在 6 月底起並不斷加碼購入台中工業區內工業用地，24 日並以 13.8 億元再購入區內工業區 2 路亞泰冷藏公司的 3065 坪土地 廠房，一個月來計砸下 25.69 億元在台中工業區購地三筆。同時，大立光今年以來積極衝刺共同封裝光學的 CPO 新業務，市場認為，大立光此時連連出手獵地，應是為新事業預先暖身。
paras_en: Largan Precision (3008‑TW), a key Apple optical component supplier actively developing AI‑application photonic communication components, announced its latest revenue figures on the 5th. July 2026 revenue was NT$4.877 billion, up 31.38% month‑over‑month but down 10.66% year‑over‑year. The company attributes the rebound in July to a transition period in June where customers were swapping old models for new ones, boosting demand. Based on the current order backlog, Largan expects its operating momentum to increase further in August.
For the January‑July 2026 period, Largan’s revenue reached NT$34.086 billion, a 7.49% increase from a year earlier.

In July, the revenue mix was dominated by 10‑megapixel products, which accounted for roughly 60‑70% of sales; 20‑megapixel products made up 10‑20%; 8‑megapixel products contributed 0‑10%; and products below 5 megapixels represented another 10‑20%.

Largan continues to acquire land in the Taichung Industrial Zone. The board also approved a dividend of NT$41.5 per share for the first half of 2026, with the ex‑dividend date set for August 13, following the company’s usual calendar.

From its H1 2026 financial results, Largan posted revenue of NT$29.209 billion, a gross margin of 49.41%, and net profit after tax of NT$10.793 billion, equating to earnings of NT$82.35 per share. With a dividend of NT$41.5 per share, the payout ratio was 50.39%, higher than the NT$28 per share paid in the same period last year.

Since the end of June, Largan has been steadily increasing its purchase of industrial land in the Taichung Industrial Zone. On the 24th, it spent NT$1.38 billion to acquire a 3,065‑ping (≈10,100 sqm) plot from Yatai Cold Storage Company on Road 2 of the zone. Over the past month, Largan has invested a total of NT$2.569 billion in three land deals in the area. At the same time, the company has been aggressively pursuing a new co‑packaged optics business (CPO). Market observers believe that Largan’s recent land acquisitions are a pre‑emptive move to warm up for this new venture.

items.title: 〈陸股盤後〉午後維持高檔震盪格局 三大指數走高
items.title_en: Hong Kong Stocks Maintain High-Profile Volatility Amidst Tech Sector Resilience
paras: 中國A股三大指數5日（周三）集體開低，早盤兩市單邊上行，午前漲幅擴大，午後維持高檔震盪格局。
滬深兩市成交總額為人民幣2.6596兆元，較前一交易日增加4,460億元。
中信建投表示，科技主線的全球共振仍在延續。後市需關注量能能否持續維持在人民幣2兆以上，以及科技類股內部是否出現從硬體向應用端的輪動擴散。
綜合看，市場短期可能呈現「指數震盪、科技強者恆強」格局，賺錢效應高度集中於AI算力產業鏈，但投資人需警惕連續大漲後獲利回吐壓力。
針對當前A股市場走勢，中國銀河證券首席策略分析師楊超表示，短期來看，市場很可能會以震盪整理、結構再平衡為核心特徵，隨著賽道擁擠度回落、國內政策持續托底、長線資金不斷入場，指數進一步下探空間顯著收斂。
時序進入8月，上市公司半年報密集發布，投資人可持續關注具備真實業績兌現能力、景氣確定性更強的細分標的。
中長期科技成長產業趨勢並未終結，後續行情將由普漲行情轉向依靠業績篩選的結構性機會，市場主線可能從上半年單一主線走向多線並行。
paras_en: The CSI 300 Index, a benchmark for China's A-share market, rose 1.47% to 3,878.43 points on Wednesday, while the Shenzhen Component Index gained 1.86% to 14,144.2 points. The ChiNext Index, which tracks China's growth enterprises board, rose 1.32% to 3,535.14 points.
The combined turnover of the Shanghai and Shenzhen stock exchanges reached 2.6596 trillion yuan, up 444 billion yuan from the previous trading day.

China International Capital Corporation (CICC) said that the global resonance of the tech sector is still ongoing. Market participants should pay attention to whether the volume can maintain above 2 trillion yuan and whether there is a rotation from hardware to application-oriented stocks within the tech sector.

In the short term, the market may exhibit a 'index volatility, tech sector resilience' pattern, with a high concentration of profit-taking effects in the AI computing industry chain. However, investors should be cautious of the potential for profit-taking pressure after a prolonged rally.

China Galaxy Securities' chief strategist, Yang Chao, said that in the short term, the market is likely to feature a 'shaking off, structural rebalancing' pattern, with the index further narrowing its downward space as the sector's overcrowding decreases, domestic policies continue to provide support, and long-term capital continues to flow in.

As the market enters August, investors can focus on companies that have delivered real earnings and have stronger economic certainty. The long-term trend of the tech growth industry has not come to an end, and the subsequent market trend will shift from a broad rally to a structural opportunity based on earnings selection. The market's main theme may transition from a single mainline in the first half to a multi-line trend.
The CSI 300 Index rose 1.47% to 3,878.43 points, the Shenzhen Component Index gained 1.86% to 14,144.2 points, and the ChiNext Index rose 1.32% to 3,535.14 points.

items.title: 英飛凌Q3營收創歷史新高 AI資料中心與車用回溫成雙引擎
items.title_en: Infineon Q3 Revenue Hits Record High on AI Data Center and Automotive Demand
paras: 德國半導體大廠英飛凌 (Infineon Technologies) 周三 (5 日) 公布 2026 會計年度第三季 (截至 6 月 30 日) 財報，受惠於人工智慧 (AI) 資料中心需求熱絡與車用電子市場回溫，當季營收達 41.72 億歐元，創下公司歷史單季新高。執行長 Jochen Hanebeck 指出，英飛凌已成功進入成長軌道，多個目標市場均呈現積極態勢。
在財務表現方面，第三季營收較上季成長 9%，主要動能來自「電源與感測系統」(PSS) 及「車用電子」(ATV) 兩大部門，分別貢獻了 1.82 億歐元與 1.02 億歐元的增量。當季毛利率升至 40.8%，分部利潤 (Segment Result) 成長至 7.97 億歐元，分部利潤率達 19.1%。
儘管獲利數據略低於部分分析師預期，但強勁的營收表現反映了 AI 基礎建設對電力管理晶片的迫切需求。
英飛凌強調，AI 資料中心的電源供應解決方案是目前最重要的成長驅動力。公司已與多家 AI 生態系領先客戶達成多年產能預約協議，潛在營收規模高達數十億歐元。此外，全球電網基礎建設投資的增加也帶來利多。
在車用市場方面，雖然電動車高壓元件需求相對平淡，但軟體定義汽車 (SDV) 趨勢持續，帶動車用訂單明顯回升。
展望未來，英飛凌預測第四季營收將進一步增至約 47 億歐元，分部利潤率可望提升至 23%。公司將全年營收目標定為約 163 億歐元。
在策略布局上，英飛凌於 2026 年 7 月順利完成收購艾邁斯歐司朗 (ams OSRAM) 的感測器產品組合。同時，公司計畫維持全年 27 億歐元的資本支出，重點投入德勒斯登 (Dresden) 新廠的產能建設，以應對 AI 客戶的長期需求。
paras_en: Infineon Technologies, a German semiconductor giant, reported its third-quarter 2026 financial results on Wednesday, benefiting from the surge in demand for artificial intelligence (AI) data centers and the recovery of the automotive electronics market. The company's revenue for the quarter reached €4.172 billion, a new record high for a single quarter. CEO Jochen Hanebeck stated that Infineon has successfully entered a growth trajectory, with multiple target markets showing an optimistic outlook.

In terms of financial performance, the third-quarter revenue grew 9% compared to the previous quarter, mainly driven by the 'Power and Sensor Systems' (PSS) and 'Automotive Electronics' (ATV) business units, which contributed €182 million and €102 million in incremental revenue, respectively. The gross margin rose to 40.8%, while the segment result grew to €797 million, with a segment margin of 19.1%.
Although the profit data was slightly lower than some analysts' expectations, the strong revenue performance reflects the urgent demand for power management chips in AI infrastructure.

Infineon emphasized that its power supply solutions for AI data centers are the current most important growth drivers. The company has signed multi-year capacity reservation agreements with several leading AI ecosystem customers, with potential revenue scope of tens of billions of euros. Additionally, the increasing investment in global grid infrastructure also brings benefits.

In the automotive market, although the demand for high-voltage components in electric vehicles was relatively flat, the trend of software-defined vehicles (SDV) continued, driving a significant increase in automotive orders.

Looking ahead, Infineon predicts that fourth-quarter revenue will further increase to around €4.7 billion, with a segment margin of 23%. The company sets its full-year revenue target at around €16.3 billion.

In terms of strategic layout, Infineon successfully completed the acquisition of ams OSRAM's sensor product portfolio in July 2026. Meanwhile, the company plans to maintain its capital expenditure of €2.7 billion for the year, focusing on the capacity expansion of its new factory in Dresden to meet the long-term demands of AI customers.

items.title: 史上最強單月營收快衝上兆元了 鴻海7月營收9465億元月增15%改寫新高
items.title_en: Hon Hai's July Revenue Surges to NT$946.5 Billion, a New Record High
paras: 鴻海(2317-TW)今(5)日公告 7 月營收9465.12億元，創歷史單月新高，為台股首家有望成為單月兆元營收的廠商，月增15.18%、年增54.19%；累計前7月營收5.59兆元也是同期新高，年增37.89%。
鴻海預期，第三季 AI 機櫃保持成長趨勢，且 ICT 產品進入下半年旺季，營運將逐漸加溫，單季營運將會有季增及年增的表現；鴻海也預計將於8月12日召開法說並公告第二季財報。
鴻海四大產品類別7月表現來看，與上月相比，雲端網路產品受惠AI產品拉或動能，營收強勁成長；電腦終端產品同樣強勁成長，元件及其他產品、消費智能產品則呈顯著成長。
與去年同期相比，四大產品類別均強勁成長，其中，消費智能產品、電腦終端產品受惠拉貨動能及出貨價格提高影響；累計前7月來看，雲端網路產品、元件及其他產品強勁成長，消費智能產品、電腦終端產品則顯著成長。
paras_en: Hon Hai (2317-TW) announced today that its July revenue reached NT$946.5 billion, a new record high, making it the first Taiwanese company to potentially reach NT$1 trillion in revenue in a single month. The revenue increased by 15.18% from the previous month and 54.19% from the same period last year. Cumulatively, the company's revenue for the first seven months reached NT$5.59 trillion, also a new high, with a year-on-year growth of 37.89%.

Hon Hai expects its AI machine business to continue growing in the third quarter, and its ICT products to enter the peak season in the second half of the year, leading to a gradual increase in operating temperature. The company also plans to hold an investor conference on August 12 and announce its second-quarter earnings.

Looking at Hon Hai's four major product categories in July, cloud network products benefited from the growth of AI products, with strong revenue growth. Computer terminal products also showed strong growth, while component and other products, as well as consumer smart products, showed significant growth compared to the previous month.

Compared to the same period last year, all four major product categories showed strong growth. Consumer smart products and computer terminal products benefited from the growth of inventory and increased sales prices. Cumulatively, cloud network products, components and other products showed strong growth, while consumer smart products and computer terminal products showed significant growth.

items.title: 8月底完成簽約！傳DeepSeek重啟二輪融資 擬募資500億人民幣  投前估值5000億
items.title_en: DeepSeek to Complete Second Round of Financing by End of August, Aims to Raise 50 Billion CNY, Valuation of 50 Billion USD
paras: 中國雜誌《財經》週三(5日)引述多名交易人士報導，中國AI大模型公司DeepSeek已重啟第二輪融資，計畫募資500億元(人民幣，下同)，投前估值約5000億元，目標8月下旬完成簽約。
報導指出，DeepSeek本輪融資在7月中啟動、7月底曾因投資人會議實錄外洩風波暫停，重啟後公司與洽談方均要求低調推進，部分前期接觸機構尚未接到重啟通知。
DeepSeek首輪融資於今年4月開啟、6月交割，金額500億元、估值逾3500億元，寫下中國AI大模型首輪規模紀錄。出資陣容橫跨創辦人、網路巨頭與產業資本；梁文鋒個人出資約200億元，騰訊100億元，寧德時代體系50億元，京東、網易、IDG資本各30億元，礪思資本、正心谷、拾象資本等跟進，國家人工智慧產業投資基金亦入局。首輪意向資金超千億，份額供不應求。
DeepSeek第二輪談判名單兼納首輪落選候補機構與既有股東增資方，投前估值較首輪跳升約43%。若順利交割，DeepSeek兩輪累計募資將突破千億元，資金預計投入新一代模型研發、算力基礎設施與商業化落地。
憑藉低成本高性能路線及推理、程式碼生成表現，DeepSeek已成為中國基礎模型賽道標竿，二輪高估值亦反映資本市場對國產通用人工智慧(AGI)長期價值的重估。
截至發稿，DeepSeek目前尚未回應媒體置評請求。
paras_en: Chinese AI model company DeepSeek has restarted its second round of financing, aiming to raise 500 billion CNY, with a pre-investment valuation of approximately 50 billion USD, with the goal of completing the agreement by the end of August.

According to reports from multiple sources, DeepSeek's second round of financing was launched in mid-July, but was temporarily suspended at the end of July due to a leak of investment meeting records. After restarting, both the company and the negotiating parties have requested a low-key approach to the talks.
Some of the institutions that were in contact with DeepSeek earlier have not yet received notification of the restart.

DeepSeek's first round of financing was launched in April this year and was completed in June, raising 500 billion CNY and valuing the company at over 35 billion USD, setting a record for the largest first-round financing in China's AI model sector.

The investors in the first round include the company's founders, internet giants, and industrial capital, with Liang Wenfeng personally investing approximately 20 billion CNY, Tencent investing 10 billion CNY, and the NIO system investing 5 billion CNY, as well as JD.com, NetEase, IDG Capital, and other investors.

The second round of negotiations includes first-round unsuccessful candidates and existing shareholders who are increasing their stakes, with a pre-investment valuation that is approximately 43% higher than the first round.
If successful, DeepSeek's two rounds of financing will exceed 1 trillion CNY, with the funds expected to be invested in the development of new models, computing infrastructure, and commercialization.

Based on its low-cost, high-performance route and its performance in reasoning and code generation, DeepSeek has become a benchmark in China's basic model sector, and the high valuation of the second round reflects the capital market's re-evaluation of the long-term value of domestic general artificial intelligence (AGI).
As of the time of writing, DeepSeek has not responded to media requests for comment.

items.title: 費半階段性高點修正觸底 法人：半導體ETF打折潮後買點現
items.title_en: Semiconductor ETFs Hit Bottom After Correction, Institutions: Buying Opportunity Emerges After Discount
paras: 7 月美費半急跌、從6/22最高14,655.29點一路殺至7/17的11,194.60點止跌，波段跌幅高達-23.61%，國內半導體股也跌得鼻青臉腫，不少投資人擔心半導體股轉入熊市，不過，投信法人指出，四大雲端巨頭陸續公布最新財報後，AI資本支出金額續增，顯示AI需求暢旺，中長線成長趨勢不變，7月半導體股整體急跌，可視為階段性高點修正觸底，建議投資人著眼AI中長期成長潛力，趁8月股價震盪階段，分批布局半導體相關ETF或基金，掌握股價打折潮後的相對低點，迎接第四季台股作夢行情。
根據集保統計，截至7/31止，國內半導體ETF整體受益人數，最新來到44萬256人，較前一週的43萬8,128人，新增2,128人，再創歷史新高；最新零股人數，也維持約6.5萬人左右，居歷史高檔。若與上月相比，整體半導體ETF受益人數較6月底新增約6.6萬人左右，較去年12月底人數，也大幅增加20萬人，成長率高達84.85%，顯示今年半導體ETF受惠AI浪潮，股價大漲的同時也展現高人氣。
台新臺灣半導體30 (00904-TW) ETF經理人張意聆表示，7月半導體股大跌後急彈，反映AI進入獲利驗證期，引發資金流出高資本支出的科技股，半導體股價也陷入修正，不過，觀察美科技巨頭最新公布的財報，像CSP雲端龍頭企業，仍維持新增AI資本支出計劃；同時，CSP財報內容中，AI投資也有反映公司獲利成長跡象，顯示科技大廠新增AI投資，有助於持續創造高於資金成本的價值。
張意聆強調，目前科技大廠的AI建置處於技術投資初期，2026年算是爬坡期，對於預估未來AI收入及生產效益將於2027年滯後顯現，預估半導體股價短期內，仍將受高利率、AI商業化驗證壓抑評價，但進入8月起至今年底，只要美國利率緊縮預期降溫，資金壓力緩解，半導體股估值有望快速修復，7月股價下殺應屬正常牛市整理，整體科技股估值修復時點，可能落在今年第四季。
台新投信ETF投資團隊指出，台股8月起持續展開反攻，加權指數重新站回各條均線之上，除被動元件與記憶體族群止跌回升後，半導體權值股中的台積電、聯發科也同步走強，持續扮演支撐大盤的重要多頭力量，對於具台積電的高含積半導體ETF，股價也有機會隨AI落地題材發威，是掌握第三、四季台股反彈行情的多頭主攻手，值得投資人優先卡位布局。

paras_en: The US semiconductor index plummeted in July, falling from its highest point of 14,655.29 on June 22 to 11,194.60 on July 17, a drop of 23.61%. Domestic semiconductor stocks also fell sharply, leaving many investors worried that the sector is entering a bear market. However, institutional investors pointed out that after the four major cloud giants announced their latest financial reports, AI capital expenditures continued to increase, indicating strong demand for AI and an unchanged long-term growth trend. The sharp drop in semiconductor stocks in July can be seen as a correction and a buying opportunity, and investors are advised to focus on the long-term growth potential of AI and take advantage of the price fluctuations in August to invest in semiconductor-related ETFs or funds.

According to the Taiwan Depository & Clearing Corporation, as of July 31, the number of beneficiaries of domestic semiconductor ETFs reached a new high of 442,256, an increase of 2,128 from the previous week. The number of zero-share holders remained at around 65,000, a historical high. Compared to the previous month, the number of beneficiaries of semiconductor ETFs increased by approximately 66,000 from the end of June, and by 200,000 from the end of last year, with a growth rate of 84.85%. This shows that semiconductor ETFs have been popular this year, driven by the AI trend, with prices rising and high demand.

The manager of the Fubon Taiwan Semiconductor 30 ETF (00904-TW), Chang Yi-Ling, stated that after the sharp drop in semiconductor stocks in July, the subsequent rebound reflects the entry into a period of profit verification for AI, leading to a outflow of funds from high-capital-expenditure tech stocks and a correction in semiconductor stock prices. However, observing the latest financial reports of US tech giants, such as CSP, a cloud leader, AI capital expenditures continue to increase, and AI investments are also reflected in the company's profit growth, indicating that tech giants' AI investments can create value above their cost of capital.

Chang emphasized that the current AI investment by tech giants is in its early stages, with 2026 being a period of rapid growth, and the benefits of AI revenue and production are expected to emerge in 2027. It is expected that semiconductor stock prices will continue to be suppressed by high interest rates and AI commercialization verification in the short term, but from August to the end of the year, if US interest rate expectations cool down and funding pressure eases, semiconductor stock valuations are likely to recover quickly, and the July price drop should be seen as a normal bull market correction. The timing of the overall tech stock valuation recovery may be in the fourth quarter.

Fubon Asset Management's ETF investment team pointed out that the Taiwanese stock market will continue to rebound from August, with the weighted index regaining its footing above the moving averages. In addition to the rebound of passive components and memory chips, semiconductor heavyweights such as TSMC and MediaTek are also gaining strength, playing an important role in supporting the market. For high-conviction semiconductor ETFs with TSMC, there is also an opportunity for prices to rise with the AI theme, making them a key player in the third and fourth quarter market rebound, and worth investors' attention and investment.

items.title: 大立光7月營收48.77億元月增31.38% 本月拉貨動能再看增
items.title_en: Largan Precision Reports July Revenue of NT$4.877 Billion, Up 31.38% MoM; Momentum from Stockpiling Expected to Continue Growing
paras: 積極投入 AI 應用光通訊元件開發的蘋果光學元件供應鏈大立光 (3008-TW)， 今 (5) 日公布最新營收資訊，大立光 2026 年 7月營收爲 48.77 億元，月增31.38%，年減10.66%，大立光度過6月客戶端在進行新舊機種交替期而推升7 月營收動能回升，以目前大立光掌握的訂單來看，大立光8月營運動能還要再增。
大立光 7月 營收結構中，以 1000 萬畫素產品占多數，占比約 60-70%，2000 萬畫素產品占比 10-20%，800 萬畫素產品 0-10%，低於 500 萬畫素產品占比 10-20%。
大立光在台中工業區購地接連出手加碼中，同時，大立光董事會決議對 2026 年上半年的股利配發案，將配發每股 41.5 元，而依大立光歷年行事曆，大立光上半年的股息將在 8 月 13 日除息交易。
大立光通過 2026 年上半年財報，營收 292.09 億元，毛利率 49.41%，稅後純益 107.93 億元，每股純益 82.35 元。以 41.5 元的上半年配息而言，盈餘配發率爲 50.39%。大立光上半年配息也優於去年同期的 28 元。
大立光在 6 月底起並不斷加碼購入台中工業區內工業用地，24 日並以 13.8 億元再購入區內工業區 2 路亞泰冷藏公司的 3065 坪土地 廠房，一個月來計砸下 25.69 億元在台中工業區購地三筆。同時，大立光今年以來積極衝刺共同封裝光學的 CPO 新業務，市場認為，大立光此時連連出手獵地，應是為新事業預先暖身。
paras_en: Largan Precision (3008‑TW), a key Apple optical component supplier actively developing AI‑application photonic communication components, announced its latest revenue figures on the 5th. July 2026 revenue was NT$4.877 billion, up 31.38% month‑over‑month but down 10.66% year‑over‑year. The company attributes the rebound in July to a transition period in June where customers were swapping old models for new ones, boosting demand. Based on the current order backlog, Largan expects its operating momentum to increase further in August.
For the January‑July 2026 period, Largan’s revenue reached NT$34.086 billion, a 7.49% increase from a year earlier.

In July, the revenue mix was dominated by 10‑megapixel products, which accounted for roughly 60‑70% of sales; 20‑megapixel products made up 10‑20%; 8‑megapixel products contributed 0‑10%; and products below 5 megapixels represented another 10‑20%.

Largan continues to acquire land in the Taichung Industrial Zone. The board also approved a dividend of NT$41.5 per share for the first half of 2026, with the ex‑dividend date set for August 13, following the company’s usual calendar.

From its H1 2026 financial results, Largan posted revenue of NT$29.209 billion, a gross margin of 49.41%, and net profit after tax of NT$10.793 billion, equating to earnings of NT$82.35 per share. With a dividend of NT$41.5 per share, the payout ratio was 50.39%, higher than the NT$28 per share paid in the same period last year.

Since the end of June, Largan has been steadily increasing its purchase of industrial land in the Taichung Industrial Zone. On the 24th, it spent NT$1.38 billion to acquire a 3,065‑ping (≈10,100 sqm) plot from Yatai Cold Storage Company on Road 2 of the zone. Over the past month, Largan has invested a total of NT$2.569 billion in three land deals in the area. At the same time, the company has been aggressively pursuing a new co‑packaged optics business (CPO). Market observers believe that Largan’s recent land acquisitions are a pre‑emptive move to warm up for this new venture.

items.title: 史上最強單月營收快衝上兆元了 鴻海7月營收9465億元月增15%改寫新高
items.title_en: Hon Hai's July Revenue Surges to NT$946.5 Billion, a New Record High
paras: 鴻海(2317-TW)今(5)日公告 7 月營收9465.12億元，創歷史單月新高，為台股首家有望成為單月兆元營收的廠商，月增15.18%、年增54.19%；累計前7月營收5.59兆元也是同期新高，年增37.89%。
鴻海預期，第三季 AI 機櫃保持成長趨勢，且 ICT 產品進入下半年旺季，營運將逐漸加溫，單季營運將會有季增及年增的表現；鴻海也預計將於8月12日召開法說並公告第二季財報。
鴻海四大產品類別7月表現來看，與上月相比，雲端網路產品受惠AI產品拉或動能，營收強勁成長；電腦終端產品同樣強勁成長，元件及其他產品、消費智能產品則呈顯著成長。
與去年同期相比，四大產品類別均強勁成長，其中，消費智能產品、電腦終端產品受惠拉貨動能及出貨價格提高影響；累計前7月來看，雲端網路產品、元件及其他產品強勁成長，消費智能產品、電腦終端產品則顯著成長。
paras_en: Hon Hai (2317-TW) announced today that its July revenue reached NT$946.5 billion, a new record high, making it the first Taiwanese company to potentially reach NT$1 trillion in revenue in a single month. The revenue increased by 15.18% from the previous month and 54.19% from the same period last year. Cumulatively, the company's revenue for the first seven months reached NT$5.59 trillion, also a new high, with a year-on-year growth of 37.89%.

Hon Hai expects its AI machine business to continue growing in the third quarter, and its ICT products to enter the peak season in the second half of the year, leading to a gradual increase in operating temperature. The company also plans to hold an investor conference on August 12 and announce its second-quarter earnings.

Looking at Hon Hai's four major product categories in July, cloud network products benefited from the growth of AI products, with strong revenue growth. Computer terminal products also showed strong growth, while component and other products, as well as consumer smart products, showed significant growth compared to the previous month.

Compared to the same period last year, all four major product categories showed strong growth. Consumer smart products and computer terminal products benefited from the growth of inventory and increased sales prices. Cumulatively, cloud network products, components and other products showed strong growth, while consumer smart products and computer terminal products showed significant growth.
